_: Per-file size budgets for ui/src, and the shell rule for App.tsx, read by
scripts/gates/composition.py. THIS FILE IS THE ALLOWLIST — it is the one
source, and docs/architecture/ui.md 11.7 links here rather than restating it.
A budget is a ceiling, not a target. The gate fails when a file exceeds its
budget, and when a file over default_max_lines has no entry at all. It does
NOT fail when a count drops: ratchet the number down as the file shrinks.
.ts is in scope as well as .tsx. Capping only components would let any
component meet its cap by moving the logic into a helper beside it.
'bespoke' means a deliberate exception — the file is one cohesive thing and
splitting it would invent a boundary the behaviour does not have.
'debt' means a file that should shrink, tracked by an issue. Debt is not an
exception; it is a number that should be going down.

ui/src/App.tsx.note: Being split into feature-owned components. Was 3274, then 2323 before the file explorer moved to explorer/, then 1816 once it did, then 1815 when the terminal tab panes moved to terminal/TerminalTabPanes.tsx to pay for the graph tab, then 1813 when the left sidebar's search wrapper and tree composition moved to explorer/ExplorerPanel.tsx, which paid for the Files/Tags mode switch with two lines to spare, then 1808 when equations landed: the four repeated corePluginOn(settings.corePlugins(), ...) call sites in the Editor props collapsed to a single pluginOn helper, which also made the plugin dependency check uniform. Ratchet this down as each extraction lands. Completion is not a line count: it is the three extractions the ./api/ipc waiver names — document session (done), vault boot, watcher listeners. A composition root wiring this many features lands well above default_max_lines once those are out, and chasing a smaller number would mean components taking fifteen props, which is the boundary-that-does-not-exist this gate is meant to prevent.

ui/src/api/ipc.ts.note: The whole typed IPC surface. It is one chokepoint on purpose (implementation/frontend.md), and the Setting union is the only registry of setting keys — splitting it would give that registry two homes. Raised 1103 -> 1104 for plugins.math_enabled, then 1104 -> 1173 for the graph commands and their wire types, then 1173 -> 1191 for list_tag_assignments and the ui.left_sidebar_mode key, then 1191 -> 1192 for plugins.equations_enabled: a new setting key or command costs exactly its own lines here and has nowhere else to live.

ui/src/Editor.tsx.note: CodeMirror host: extension assembly, the imperative EditorApi, and the anchor-scroll queue. Ratcheted 730 -> 721 when equations landed: math, equations and property-refs are all live-preview plugin flags, so livePreviewFor takes them as one LivePreviewPlugins record and the separate propertyRefsEnabled compartment and its reconfigure effect are gone. Ratcheted 721 -> 666 when the four hand-rolled resolver subscribe blocks collapsed into editor/updateSubscription.ts: the slot registers its own onCleanup, so a fifth resolver cannot repeat the leak the dataview copy had.

ui/src/Properties.tsx.note: The frontmatter table and its per-type cell dispatch.

ui/src/editor/decorations.ts.note: One Lezer tree walk producing every Live Preview decoration. Splitting by mark type would mean several walks, against the measured-performance bar.

ui/src/sidebar/SearchPanel.tsx.note: Query state, result grouping and the roving-tabindex result list.

ui/src/ast/normalize.ts.note: Mirrors the Rust normalizer. Divergence is a correctness bug, so it stays one file that can be diffed against its counterpart.

ui/src/sidebar/IntegrityPanel.tsx.note: Vault-health rows and their fetch effect. Raised 386 -> 388 for the refresh-is-not-a-load fix: one import and one tracker declaration. The cold/warm decision itself is shared in sidebar/refreshTarget.ts rather than inlined here, so this is the whole per-panel cost.

ui/src/settings/settingsState.ts.note: The vault's persisted configuration surface: one signal, one setter and one hydrate step per setting. Length here tracks the number of settings, not tangled logic. Raised from 381 when every default moved to settings/defaults.ts — one named constant per default, so the signal initialiser and the hydrate fallback can no longer disagree, at the cost of a wrapped line each. Raised 400 -> 421 for ui.left_sidebar_mode: one signal, one setter, one hydrate step, exactly as the note describes.

ui/src/statusbar/PendingRewrites.tsx.note: The pending-rewrites popover and its per-row apply.

ui/src/omnibar/OmniBar.tsx.note: The ranked multi-kind palette named as the one deliberately bespoke surface in architecture/ui.md 11.6.

ui/src/sidebar/UnlinkedMentions.tsx.note: Mention rows plus the untrack-your-own-writes fetch effect. Raised 276 -> 278 for the refresh-is-not-a-load fix: one import and one tracker declaration, the same two lines as IntegrityPanel.

ui/src/core/commands.ts.note: The command/keymap registry. It is the single source of truth for command ids, defaults and key matching (architecture/ui.md 11.2); splitting it would create a second place to register a command. Raised 260 -> 266 for graph.open: a command is six lines here and, by that same argument, has nowhere else to go.

./api/ipc.note: App still owns vault boot and the watcher listeners, which are the remaining direct IPC callers; the document session moved to core/documentSession.ts. The waiver goes away with the other two; do not add a second waiver to keep an IPC call in the shell.
